data.one_liner: A PageView widget that expands or shrinks its pages dynamically while scrolling vertically.
data.what_it_does: Provides an alternative PageView widget that clones the modal sheet UI found in the Apple Books app. As users scroll vertically inside a page, the viewport dynamically scales and shrinks or expands, allowing for full-screen transitions and fluid page swiping.
use_when: You want to replicate the Apple Books details modal sheet UI in your Flutter app.
You need a PageView where individual pages expand and collapse based on vertical scroll position.
You want smooth page transitions combined with custom snap insets and overshoot effects.
avoid_when: You need standard horizontal page-flipping without any vertical sizing behavior.
You require robust mouse wheel scrolling support on web for this specific widget.
strengths: Provides a unique and polished UI experience similar to native iOS Apple Books.
Highly customizable viewport fractions, insets, and snap points through ViewportConfiguration.
Supports custom scroll controllers and hero animations.
weaknesses: Mouse wheel scrolling is not currently supported on the web platform.
Requires specific usage of `PageContentScrollController.of(context)` for inner scrollables.
